records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: ONE single rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, action 038 E-AXU-005 s01 neutral seated starting position.
Input images 1–3 are strict reference photographs for the SAME adult East Asian woman, identity, black ponytail, face and skin, plain fitted white short-sleeve tee and charcoal long pants, gray-blue backdrop, soft realistic studio photographic style. They guide visual appearance, not arm poses.
Pose: woman seated upright centered on a simple stationary neutral gray chair with low back and four fixed legs, no wheels or swivel, no armrests. BOTH buttocks/sitting bones on the seat, pelvis level facing directly forward. Both thighs/knees and white flat low-top athletic sneakers point forward, feet hip width flat on floor, hips and knees comfortably about 90 degrees. Both hands gently crossed in front of chest, fingertips resting lightly on opposite upper chest below clavicles, relaxed elbows pointing down. Shoulders and chest face the camera, head neutral calm face toward camera, no rotation or sidebend.
Camera: straight FRONT full-body view at seated chest height, portrait 4:5 approximately1122×1402. Entire head, both hands and forearms, pelvis, both knees, whole chair, both shoes, chair legs and floor contact points visible with comfortable margin. Natural adult head/torso/limb proportions, correct fingers/joints.
Scene: cool gray-blue seamless studio backdrop/floor matching references, soft diffuse lighting, subtle natural shadows. Only one woman and one chair. No written text, numbering, labels, arrows, multi-panel, collage, watermark or other props. This will be the locked start frame for same-chair left and right chest rotation photographs; leave enough space around shoulders.
records.visual_review: 已看图：正面坐稳、不转无扶手椅，手轻交叉胸前，膝足朝前、双脚踩地；坐位中立，头手鞋完整，比例正常。

records.prompt:

Input 1 is locked neutral seated frame038-s01. Inputs2–4 are original woman's identity and studio style references. Edit only upper body's rotation, preserving exact same woman, hair, face identity, white tee/charcoal pants/white sneakers, camera position, portrait framing, subject scale, gray-blue background/floor, lighting, stationary gray non-swivel chair and chair legs.
From this starting posture rotate her CHEST/RIBCAGE and shoulder girdle about30degrees toward HER ANATOMICAL LEFT, which is IMAGE RIGHT. Chest clearly faces diagonally toward image RIGHT, not straight forward. Right shoulder (image-left) comes slightly toward camera, left shoulder (image-right) moves farther back; face and neck naturally follow chest toward image right. BOTH hands remain lightly crossed over upper chest, hands and elbows move as a unit with the ribcage, no pulling, no grabbing chair. Both sitting bones maintain seat contact, both white sneakers remain flat on floor unchanged. This visible difference between rotated CHEST and FORWARD KNEES is the key requirement. Chair never rotates or moves. Keep full head, both hands, knees, chair and complete shoes visible. Natural adult anatomy, ordinary modest comfortable twist, no exaggerated end range. No text, arrows, labels, numbers, montage or watermark.
